profile.bio: Christopher Tang is a University Distinguished Professor and the holder of the Edward W. Carter Chair in Business Administration at the UCLA Anderson School of Management at University of California, Los Angeles.[1] He received his B.Sc. (First class honours) in Mathematics from King's College London in 1981, M.A. in Statistics in 1983, M.Phil in Administrative Science in 1983, and Ph.D. in Operations Research in 1985 from Yale University.

works.title: Lego’s ESG dilemma: Why an abandoned plan to use recycled plastic bottles is a wake-up call for supply chain sustainability
